title: The Dumb Book (The Botanist's Garden)
summary: Between the yellowed pages of the old botanical herbarium rested dried alpine gentians, sea-grasses, and clover blossoms gathered over six decades of study....
full_text:
Between the yellowed pages of the old botanical herbarium rested dried alpine gentians, sea-grasses, and clover blossoms gathered over six decades of study.

Though silent, the leaves spoke eloquently of mountain climbs undertaken with friends long departed, of quiet hours by riverbanks with a beloved mother, and of the sacred harmony of creation. The botanist slept beneath the churchyard grass, but his silent book continued to breathe the fragrance of an honorable life.
moral: Every pressed leaf preserves a heartbeat of human love and dedication.
